info.name: JSView — Purchase Request & Purchase Order
info.description:
# JSView Purchase Request (PR) and Purchase Order (PO)

There is **no separate PR URL**. PR and PO share the same jewelry API. The only difference is `potype`:

| Type | `potype` | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Purchase Request | `REQUEST` | Uses the live cost card. No frozen snapshot. |
| Purchase Order | `ORDER` | Frozen cost-card snapshot is created when a line with `costcardid` is saved. |

Prefix: `{{baseUrl}}/api/purchase-order/`

**Auth:** InvenTree requires login. Set collection variable `token` (from `/api/user/token/` or the UI) and send header `Authorization: Token {{token}}`.

**Not these URLs:** frontend `ApiEndpoints.purchase_order_list` (`/api/order/po/`) is upstream InvenTree purchasing, not this jewelry PO app.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| GET/POST | `/api/purchase-order/po/` | List / create header. Filter PR with `?potype=REQUEST`, PO with `?potype=ORDER`. |
| GET/PATCH/PUT/DELETE | `/api/purchase-order/po/{{id}}/` | Header detail. GET includes nested `lines`. |
| GET | `/api/purchase-order/po/{{id}}/lines/` | Lines for that header only. |
| GET/POST | `/api/purchase-order/po-line/` | All lines, or create a line (`poid` required). |
| GET/PATCH/PUT/DELETE | `/api/purchase-order/po-line/{{id}}/` | Single line. |

Pagination: `limit` (default 10, max 100), `offset`.

List filters: `potype`, `pocategory`, `customerid`, `vendorid`, `stampid`, `acexeid`, `termsid`, `active`.
Search: `search` on `pono`, `customer_pono`, `rem`, `note`.
Ordering: `ordering` e.g. `-podate`, `npono`, `tqty`.

## Header body (POST/PATCH)

**Required:** `podate` (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
**Do not send:** `pono`, `npono`, `nyear` (auto), `lines`, `*_name` fields, `pk` on create, `created_at`, `updated_at`.

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| potype | `REQUEST` or `ORDER` | Default `ORDER`. |
| podate | date | Required. |
| linkid | int or null | On an ORDER, PK of the source REQUEST. |
| prepby | string | Prepared by. |
| ddate | date | Delivery date. |
| vcsdate | date | Vendor confirmed ship date. |
| esdstone | date | Expected stone delivery. |
| customerid | int | `company.Company` PK (customer). |
| customer_pono | string | Customer PO reference. |
| pocategory | string | e.g. Production, Sample. Sample categories (`Sample`, `CZ Sample`, `CZ Host Sample`, `Photo Sample`) get PO number prefix `S`, others `P`. |
| rem | string | Remarks. |
| note | string | Internal notes. |
| stampid | int | `master.Stamp` PK. |
| acexeid | int | `master.ACExecutive` PK. |
| vendorid | int | `company.Company` PK (vendor). |
| tqty | int | Total qty. |
| termsid | int | `master.Terms` PK. |
| luser | string | Last user. |
| canc_dt / canc_rem / canc_user | date / string / string | Cancellation. |
| active | bool | Default true. |

`pono` format: `{customer_code} {year}-{npono:04d} {P|S}` e.g. `UNK 2026-0001 P`.

Convert REQUEST → ORDER: create ORDER with `potype: ORDER` and `linkid: <request pk>`. The REQUEST `linkid` is updated to point at the new ORDER.

## Line body (POST/PATCH)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| poid | int | Header PK. Required on create. |
| costcardid | int | `costcard.CostCard` PK. ORDER lines with this freeze a snapshot. REQUEST does not snapshot. |
| styleno | string | Internal style no. |
| vstyleno | string | Vendor style no. |
| vendorid | int | Line vendor company PK. |
| qty | int | Quantity. |
| size | string | e.g. `"7,8,9"`. |
| spcs | string | Pieces per size e.g. `"100,200,300"`. |
| stnoauto | int | Stone sequence. |
| active | bool | |

## Suggested flow

1. POST PR (`potype: REQUEST`). Collection saves `prId`.
2. POST line with `poid = {{prId}}`.
3. POST PO (`potype: ORDER`, `linkid = {{prId}}`). Collection saves `poId`.
4. POST line with `poid = {{poId}}` and `costcardid` to freeze the cost card.

Lookup helpers: `GET {{baseUrl}}/api/company/?is_customer=true`, `GET {{baseUrl}}/api/company/?is_supplier=true`, `GET {{baseUrl}}/api/costcard/`, `GET {{baseUrl}}/api/master/stamp/`, `GET {{baseUrl}}/api/master/terms/` (exact master paths may differ; use the OpenAPI schema if a path 404s).

request.description:
If this 401s, log in via the JSView UI and copy the API token from the user profile, then paste it into collection variable `token`.

Some InvenTree setups accept:
`POST {{baseUrl}}/api-token-auth/` with `{ "username", "password" }`.
Returns paginated PR headers. Always send `potype=REQUEST` so ORDER rows are excluded.
Creates the PR header then its `items` in one POST. Do not send `prepby` (set from the logged-in user) or `poid` on items. `vendorid` is null on PR. Saves `prId` on 201.

body.raw:
{
  "potype": "REQUEST",
  "podate": "2026-09-12",
  "ddate": "2026-10-01",
  "customerid": {{customerId}},
  "customer_pono": "CUST-PR-001",
  "pocategory": "Production",
  "stampid": null,
  "acexeid": null,
  "termsid": null,
  "vendorid": null,
  "vcsdate": null,
  "rem": "Sample purchase request",
  "note": "Internal notes from the Note UI",
  "tqty": 0,
  "active": true,
  "items": [
    {
      "costcardid": {{costcardId}},
      "styleno": "JS-001",
      "vstyleno": "V-001",
      "vendorid": {{vendorId}},
      "qty": 10,
      "size": "7,8,9",
      "spcs": "4,3,3"
    }
  ]
}

request.description: Partial update. Do not change `potype` to ORDER here — create a new ORDER with `linkid` instead.
Only lines whose `poid` is this request.
REQUEST lines do **not** freeze a cost-card snapshot. `costcardid` still links to the live card.
Cascades header lines. Run last if you are cleaning up test data.
Creates the ORDER header then `items` in one POST. Pass `vendorid`. Set `linkid` to the REQUEST pk. Do not send `prepby`.
ORDER with no `linkid` (not converted from a request).
There is no `/cancel/` action. Set cancellation fields on the header.

item.name: Add line to this PO (snapshots cost card)

request.description: For `potype=ORDER`, saving a line with `costcardid` copies the cost card into `POCostCard` / `POCostCardLine` (frozen names). Re-saving the same poid+costcard does not duplicate. There is **no** snapshot list API yet.
